sourceFile: 9. BRS-161014  Report test change time dry VP+CD (1st) 2023.11.06_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the report but misgroups conditions and includes invalid measurement evidence.
issues: Primary change should be dry time/speed 44.8 to 38/3.8, not UV peak/total values.
Rows 18-24 second and third rounds are omitted from comparable outcomes.
Measurement outcome is spurious; counts were treated as spec statistics using only header evidence.
Baseline/test labels need round-level preservation due inconsistent 38 vs 3.8 wording.
Conclusion rows are not cited for first-round vs later-round interpretation.
correctionPlan: Define one changed factor as dry time/speed reduction from normal 44.8 to test 38 or 3.8.
Create separate subresults for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd round comparisons using paired rows 14/16, 18/20, and 22/24.
Treat peak/total energy as subgroup or secondary condition, not the primary changed factor.
Remove the invalid measurement/spec outcome and keep defect categories as outcome components if needed.
Cite purpose/content, header, all paired result rows, and conclusion rows 26-27.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient and partly misused; corrected round-level result citations are required.
